Container.Name: AMP-v3
Container.Overview: Community-maintained AMP 3 beta container for Linux/amd64. Requires an appropriate CubeCoders licence. The panel and managed game servers run together inside this container. First startup installs AMP and can take several minutes. Persistent state is stored in /opt/cubecoders/amp3/data. Only the panel port is mapped by default; each hosted game requires its own TCP/UDP port mappings. This container requires SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, and writable cgroup access for systemd and the AMP system agent. Unraid compatibility testing is pending.
Container.License: Repository code, templates and metadata: MIT. AMP software and branding: separate CubeCoders terms.

Config.Name: Systemd log target
Config.Description: Console output keeps systemd startup failures visible in Docker logs.

Config.Name: Systemd log level
Config.Description: Systemd log verbosity. Use debug temporarily for startup diagnostics.

Config.Name: AMP panel port
Config.Description: Host port for the AMP web panel. Container port remains 8443.

Config.Name: AMP 3 data
Config.Description: Persistent AMP state and game-server data. A dedicated AMP 3 directory is required.

Config.Name: Systemd cgroups
Config.Description: Required writable cgroup mount for systemd and the AMP system agent.

Config.Name: AMP release stream
Config.Description: AMP installation stream: preview, mainline, or development. The AMP 3 beta uses preview.

Config.Name: Installer language
Config.Description: Installer language: en, de, fr, or nl.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Container time zone, for example America/Denver.

Config.Name: Internal panel port
Config.Description: Internal AMP port. Must match the container port in the panel mapping and WebUI.
